- The employer must submit a labor insurance and labor pension combined application form (勞保、勞退2合1加保申報表) to the Labor Insurance Bureau on the day the student starts work. [1]
- If the employer fails to report the student to the Labor Insurance Bureau on the day the student starts work, they will be fined 4× the labor insurance premium and 10× the employment insurance premium, and must compensate the student for any loss of benefits. [1]

- A bachelor's degree takes four years and at least 128 credits in total. [3]
- Your department may require more credits; its curriculum table has the exact number. [3]
- Contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs 教務處課務組 at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [3]

- A student admitted on an equivalent qualification from a foreign, Hong Kong, or Macau school that ends at the level of Taiwan's second year of senior high school must complete 12 more graduation credits on top of the usual requirements. [4]
- Military training and PE do not count toward these 12 additional credits. [4]
- For more details, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [4]

- In the first year, you must take at least 16 credits each semester. [5]
- In the fourth year, you must take at least 9 credits each semester. [5]

- International students must take the full‑year 5‑credit course “Chinese for Overseas Chinese Students” instead of the local students’ 3‑credit Chinese (A) plus 2‑credit Chinese (B) course. [1]
- The 5‑credit course is required for all overseas Chinese and international students. [1]
- Local students normally take 3 credits of Chinese (A) and 2 credits of Chinese (B), but international students only take the 5‑credit course. [1]
- For more details, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [1]

- You must take 6 credits of Mandarin courses at the Language Center. [2]
- You must file for the Chinese course substitution before you graduate. [2]
- The requirement differs from Article 3 of the common-course regulations, which requires 5 credits of Chinese for Overseas Chinese Students. [2]
- For more details, contact the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [2]

- Students are required to take five physical education courses in five semesters (including Freshman PE I, Freshman PE II, and three PE interest electives in the following three semesters), but any course credit earned from these five PE courses does not count toward the number of course credits required for graduation. [3]
- After the five semesters you may take a 1-credit PE course, which also does not count toward graduation. [3]
- The five required PE courses are listed as follows: Freshman PE I and II plus three PE interest electives. [3]
- The courses are taught by the Division of Curriculum, Office of Academic Affairs (教務處課務組) at https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw. [3]

- 負責人：勞動力發展署 (Workforce Development Agency, Ministry of Labor) [4]

- 畢業後可申請延期居留，經許可可延長1年，且可再申請一次，總延期期間最長為2年。 [4]
- 申請時須於居留期限屆滿前30日內提交外僑居留證。 [4]

- 學士班畢業至少 128 學分。 [1]
- 依各系所規定，可能更高，請以各系應修科目表為準。 [1]
- 國立中央大學學則 第 13 條規定，本校採學年學分制，學士班學生修業期限均為四年，所修學分總數不得少於一百二十八學分。 [1]
- 如有疑問，請洽教務處課務組 https://pdc.adm.ncu.edu.tw/p/412-1019-1763.php?Lang=zh-tw。 [1]

- 學士班學生須完成中大護照 100 基本時數，否則無法領取學位證書。 [2]
- 可於【服務學習網】或【畢業審核系統】查詢完成時數。 [2]
- 如有疑問，請洽學務處服務學習發展中心 https://service-learning.ncu.edu.tw/。 [2]

- 托福 ITP 需 543 分，符合入學年度 115 或以後的畢業英語門檻。 [3]
- 托福 ITP 需 483 分，符合入學年度 114 或以前的畢業英語門檻。 [3]

- 僑保效期滿，尚未符合參加全民健保資格者，應自費參加國泰人壽醫療保險，一學期(六個月)新台幣3,000元，就醫及理賠申請規定同僑保，至符合參加全民健保資格。 [2]
- 國泰人壽僑保及國泰人壽保險請參閱「生傷病醫療保險作業要點」<https://law.ocac.gov.tw/law/LawContent.aspx?id=GL000156&kw=%e5%83%91%e7%94%9f%e5%82%b7%e7%97%85%e9%86%ab%e7%99%82%e4%bf%9d%e9%9a%aa%e4%bd%9c%e6%a5%ad%e8%a6%81%e9%bb%9e>」。 [2]

- 投保費為新臺幣4,956元，若未在台就學則為新臺幣3,000元。 [4]
- 學生自付保險費為新臺幣6,000元，若未在台就學則為新臺幣826元。 [5]

- Nếu không có đồng ý, có thể bị loại khỏi trường. [1]

- Nếu có thắc mắc, liên hệ với Trung tâm Phát triển Dịch vụ Học tập, Văn phòng Học vụ (https://service-learning.ncu.edu.tw/). [3]
